items.exampleEn: Teachers should give contextual examples, not just lists of words.
items.exampleZh: 老師應該提供有情境的例子，而不只是單字清單。
items.glossZh: 上下文的；與背景相關的

items.exampleEn: In biology class, we dissected a fish.
items.exampleZh: 在生物課上，我們解剖了一條魚。

items.exampleEn: The plan needs further elaboration before we can vote on it.
items.exampleZh: 這個計畫需要再詳細說明，我們才能投票表決。

items.exampleEn: Doctors must act ethically at all times.
items.exampleZh: 醫生在任何時候都必須遵守職業道德。

items.exampleEn: "That's not true at all!" she interjected.
New members are inducted at a small ceremony each spring.
items.exampleZh: 新會員每年春天會在一場小型儀式中正式入會。

items.exampleEn: The librarian made a methodical list of every old book.
items.exampleZh: 圖書館員有條理地把每本舊書都列成清單。

items.exampleEn: The critic offered a sharp dissection of the movie's weak points.
items.exampleZh: 那位影評人犀利地剖析了這部電影的弱點。

items.sentenceEn: May I interject a quick question here?
items.sentenceZh: 我可以在這裡插一個簡短的問題嗎？

items.audioEn: On her show, the journalist dissected the company's annual report line by line.
items.audioZh: 在她的節目上，那位記者逐行剖析了公司的年度報告。
options: She invited the boss onto her show.

items.sentenceEn: She is a methodical worker who plans every step.
items.sentenceZh: 她做事很有條理，每一步都會事先規劃。

items.sentenceEn: Today's science lesson included the dissection of a flower.
items.sentenceZh: 今天的自然課包括解剖一朵花。

items.stemEn: We must make sure the products are made ____, without harming workers.
items.stemZh: 我們必須確保產品在不傷害工人的情況下，以合乎道德的方式製造。

items.stemEn: Next month, the famous singer will be ____ into the music hall of fame.
items.stemZh: 下個月，那位知名歌手將正式入選音樂名人堂。

items.passageEn: Our writing teacher, Mr. Chen, is famous for his methodical approach. Each week, he chooses a short news article, and the class dissects it paragraph by paragraph. He asks us to look for contextual clues that explain unfamiliar words, instead of reaching for a dictionary right away. He says that reading too quickly has inherent dangers. When a student gives a short answer, he always asks for more elaboration. Students are welcome to interject a question at any time. We also discuss whether reporters behave ethically when they write about ordinary people. Last year, the school inducted him into its hall of honor for great teachers.
items.passageZh: 我們的寫作老師陳老師，以有條理的教學方式聞名。每個星期，他會挑一篇短短的新聞，全班一段一段地剖析。他要我們先找出能解釋生字的上下文線索，而不是馬上去查字典。他說，讀得太快本身就有風險。學生回答得太簡短時，他總會要求再詳細說明。同學隨時都可以插話提問。我們也會討論記者在寫一般人的故事時，行為是否合乎道德。去年，學校把他列入優良教師榮譽榜。

questions.questionZh: 陳老師要學生用什麼方法理解生字？
學生回答太簡短時，老師會怎麼做？
options: 請其他同學替他們回答

items.promptZh: 你需要一些背景資訊，才能理解這段文字。
referenceEn: You need some contextual information to understand this passage.
Some contextual information is needed to understand this paragraph.
rubricZh: 「背景資訊」可寫，例如 contextual information、contextual details 等
「這段文字」可寫，例如 this passage、this paragraph、this text 等

items.promptZh: 那位警探有條理地檢查了每一個房間。
referenceEn: The detective searched every room in a methodical way.
The detective was methodical and checked each room one by one.
rubricZh: 「有條理地」用 methodical（例如 in a methodical way、was methodical 等），也可用副詞 methodically

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似：The elaboration of the costume took the designer three months 不道地（elaboration 多指詳述或發展細節，「製作戲服」少用此字），宜改 needs further elaboration／without elaboration 類例句
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 例句改示範主要詞義「詳細說明」："The plan needs further elaboration before we can vote on it."

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似：干擾項「訓練」對 induct 未必錯——英式用法 induct new staff 即「給新員工做入職訓練」（本級 u07-l01 的 induction 也教「入職訓練」），宜換掉
執行長第②③關裁示修正：temperamentally、demographically、geologically 與 u08-l04 q13 幾乎同一組干擾項，跨課重複
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: q13 改為本課相關副詞 stylistically、acoustically、geologically（與 u08-l04 不同組）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：干擾項重複出現且一眼可排除：oval 再次出現；methodical、elaboration、oval 與被動語態動詞空格詞性不同
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: oval 換成本課 dissected（過去分詞，放得進 will be ____ into 但語意不通）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：評分要點寫死「contextual information 表示背景資訊」，未用「例如」；contextual details、contextual knowledge 等同樣正確寫法應收
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為「「背景資訊」可寫，例如 contextual information、contextual details 等」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：interject with questions 較少見
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "interject a question at any time"

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（干擾項只用已教過的字）：審查建議的 stylistically、acoustically、geologically 為本課之後才教
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為先前課副詞 inherently、credibly、obscurely（made ____ 皆不通）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（混合詞性題至少兩個干擾項放得進空格）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: methodical 換成過去分詞 cited（u08-l01）；cited、dissected 放得進 will be ____ into 但語意不通
